hero.subtitle: Full-stack web and mobile development, Java enterprise systems, and SaaS products — built to be used, not just shipped.

about.p1: I work across the stack: React and TypeScript on the frontend, Node.js, PHP and FastAPI on the backend, Flutter and Kotlin for mobile, and Java enterprise systems (EJB, Maven, multi-module EAR deployments) when the problem calls for it.
about.p2: I'm most interested in products with a real operational model behind them — inventory, payments, bookings, bilingual interfaces — not just visual polish. MyStyle, my current focus, is a made-to-measure fashion platform with a 3D garment configurator and a zero-inventory production model.
about.p3: My approach: understand the real workflow first, then choose the simplest stack that can carry it reliably.

skills.heading: Toolkit
skills.note: Grouped by area, not ranked by percentage — some of these are daily tools, others are actively being learned.

mystyle.title: MyStyle
mystyle.problem: Buying made-to-measure clothing online usually means guessing how it will fit.
mystyle.description: An AI-assisted fashion platform with 2D-to-3D garment generation, a FastAPI backend, and a React frontend. Built on a zero-inventory, made-to-measure production model for the Algerian market.
mystyle.role: Co-founder — product direction and the 3D/technical side of the platform.

mohamed_service.title: Mohamed Service
mohamed_service.problem: Finding trustworthy electronics and repair advice locally is fragmented.
mohamed_service.description: An electronics services platform offering curated products, custom sourcing, and technical reviews for phones and computers, with an Arabic-first interface.
mohamed_service.role: Designed and built the platform end to end.

resto.title: Resto Al Salam El Bayadh
resto.problem: A local restaurant needed an online presence for its menu and reservations.
resto.description: A responsive restaurant website covering menus, reservations, and local cuisine, with a clean, fast layout.

adhahi.title: Adhahi App Preview
adhahi.problem: Stakeholders needed to validate an Android app's UI before committing to native development.
adhahi.description: An enterprise-ready presentation app in React and TypeScript, showcasing a Kotlin-built Android interface through interactive UI flows.

gestionsalles.title: GestionSalles
gestionsalles.problem: Manual hall booking led to double-bookings and no bilingual support.
gestionsalles.description: A bilingual (French/Arabic) room reservation system with secure authentication, an admin dashboard, real-time availability, and double-booking prevention.
